name: portfolio-simulator-tests
description: Test harness for the Institutional Portfolio Simulator (tools/portfolio-simulator/index.html). The tool itself is a single static HTML file with no build step -- nothing here is shipped to users.

scripts.test:browser: npm run build:css && node tests/browser/sri-load.js && node tests/browser/csp-load.js && node tests/browser/desktop-diff.js && node tests/browser/mobile-audit.js && node tests/browser/heatmap-badge.js && node tests/browser/case-roundtrip.js && node tests/browser/pdf-export.js
scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{require('playwright')}catch(e){console.log('note: playwright not installed -- npm test still works, npm run test:browser does not')}"

comments.devDependencies: These mirror what index.html loads from CDNs. Versions are pinned to the exact CDN versions so the browser suites test what users actually get -- if you change a CDN version in index.html, change it here too, or the suites stop being representative.
comments.xlsx: index.html loads SheetJS 0.20.3 from cdn.sheetjs.com. npm's own 'xlsx' package is abandoned at 0.18.5 (CVE-2023-30533 prototype pollution on parse, CVE-2024-22363 ReDoS), so the tests install @e965/xlsx -- a third-party republish of the same 0.20.3 release. tests/unit/sheetjs-provenance.test.js verifies on every run that the republish is byte-identical to the official CDN file, so 'a mirror we trust' is never load-bearing. Verified 2026-09-26.
comments.test:browser: Needs a Chromium build (npx playwright install chromium). Not run in CI: slow, and it needs a browser download. sri-load and csp-load run FIRST: if the libraries or the inline program are refused, every suite after them is measuring a dead page.
comments.csp: Rebuilds the Content-Security-Policy meta tag, including the SHA-256 of the inline <script>. That hash changes every time the app code changes, so run `npm run csp -- --write` after editing index.html -- unit/csp.test.js will tell you if you forgot, but only after you have pushed. A stale hash makes the browser refuse the whole program: the page renders and nothing works.
comments.build:css:app: Recompiles the Tailwind CSS that is inlined in index.html and writes it back into the <style id="tw-build"> block. Run it after adding or changing any Tailwind class, then re-run the browser suites.
comments.build:css: Builds the CSS the BROWSER SUITES inject for the baseline build, which still loads the Tailwind Play CDN. Different from build:css:app.
comments.sri: Prints <script>/<link> tags with Subresource Integrity hashes for the CDN assets. Must be run from a machine that can reach the CDNs -- the hash has to come from the bytes the CDN serves, not from a local npm copy. SRI is now APPLIED to all four scripts (round C2); use this only when changing a CDN version or host, and re-read tests/unit/cdn-provenance.test.js before re-pinning anything.
